==Description==
{{Color|{{FULLPAGENAME}}|0}} is a gear set designed by [[Hongshan Swordmancers]].
It is designed with a "gorge-sized capacity" concept by the Tianshi, and achieved "absorption and neutralization" of energy-based attacks<ref>[[Swordmancer Heavy Armor]]: Description</ref> with its Swordmancer armor system, which its energy can be depleted in overclock for life and death situations.<ref>[[Swordmancer Flint]]: Description</ref> It have passed high product validation checks<ref>[[Swordmancer TAC Gauntlets]]: Description</ref> and is designed with [[Wuling]]'s [[Blight]] environments<ref>[[Swordmancer NAV Beacon]]: Description</ref><ref>[[Swordmancer Micro Filter]]:Description</ref> and culture<ref>[[Swordmancer Light Armor]]: Description</ref> in mind.
{{Quote|Year's end. Brought my blade south. The mountain grew nine heads and roared incessantly. An auspicious day.|[[Swordmancer TAC Gloves]]: Description}}
